input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

patient_file.description: Path to the patient clinical file.

sample_file.description: Path to the sample clinical file.

linking_file.description: Path to the linking file mapping anonymized to real IDs.

study_id.description: cBioPortal study identifier used in case_lists output.

python_sif.description: Path to python-ampliseq Apptainer SIF image.

skip_mafsmith.description: Skip mafsmith VCF to MAF conversion and use stub MAFs instead.

filter_tsv_variants.description: When true, filter mutations by TSV coordinates; when false, pass all MAF mutations through.

fusion_metrics.description: Cohort-wide fusion-metrics TSV ('###' preamble, then a #Sample header). When set it is the only fusion source; rows are matched to samples on #Sample. In filter mode, Total Reads >= sv_min_supporting_reads and ZR-score >= sv_min_zr_score are kept.

sv_min_zr_score.description: Fusion ZR-score threshold (fusion_metrics in filter mode only; fusions with ZR-score >= this are kept). Unset = no ZR-score filter.

filter_gnomad_af.description: Drop mutations whose gnomAD allele frequency is above max_gnomad_af in any ancestry. Frequencies (gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes and genomes) are fetched from Genome Nexus; only variant coordinates and alleles are sent.

filter_clinvar.description: Keep only mutations whose ClinVar classification, fetched from Genome Nexus, is in clinvar_keep_classes. A conflicting call is kept when its breakdown lists one of them; a variant not in ClinVar is removed.

clinvar_keep_classes.description: Comma-separated ClinVar classifications kept by filter_clinvar (any part of a combined call such as Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic counts).

max_gnomad_af.description: gnomAD AF threshold for filter_gnomad_af (rows with AF > this are removed).

gnomad_af_columns.description: Comma-separated MAF columns compared by filter_gnomad_af (highest value present). gnomAD.AF_max is the highest of the total and every ancestry AF, exomes and genomes apart; gnomAD.AF is exomes + genomes combined, as cBioPortal shows it.

genome_nexus_url.description: Genome Nexus base URL (GRCh37) used to fetch gnomAD frequencies for filter_gnomad_af.

filter_vaf.description: Drop mutations whose VAF (t_alt_count / t_depth) is above max_vaf.

max_vaf.description: VAF threshold for filter_vaf (rows with VAF > this are removed).

filter_cnv_depth.description: Drop a sample's CNV calls unless cnv_min_depth_fraction of its Pisces variants have depth >= cnv_min_depth.

cnv_min_depth.description: Minimum variant depth for the CNV depth QC.

cnv_min_depth_fraction.description: Fraction of variants that must reach cnv_min_depth for a sample's CNV calls to be kept.

cnv_depth_pass_only.description: Count only PASS records of the Pisces VCF in the CNV depth QC.

include_seg.description: Write data_seg.txt and meta_seg.txt. cBioPortal derives Fraction Genome Altered from SEG data, so this is off by default.

seg_mean_mode.description: seg.mean: 'log2' = log2(CN/2) with CN=2 segments kept; 'cn' = raw CN with CN=2 dropped.
